# Test plates: sources and licences

The five pictures here are small cuts of public-domain and CC0 originals, fetched from the open archives named below on 2026-10-23. Each cut was resized to the width shown. `alive-snapshot.js.txt` is a frozen copy of this package's own `alive.js`, so the code-mosaic golden does not move when the code does; `.gitattributes` keeps its line endings as they are.

| File | Size | Title | Creator | Date | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `goya-nobody.png` | 200 x 290 | Nobody knows himself, plate six from Los Caprichos | Francisco José de Goya y Lucientes | 1797/99 | Art Institute of Chicago, https://www.artic.edu/artworks/123767 | CC0 |
| `munchausen-dore.png` | 240 x 323 | Illustration for The Adventures of Baron Munchausen | Gustave Doré | 1862 | Wikimedia Commons, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dore-munchausen-illustration.jpg | public domain |
| `muybridge-758.png` | 1600 x 903 | Animal Locomotion, Plate 758 | Eadweard Muybridge | 1887 | Art Institute of Chicago, https://www.artic.edu/artworks/195560 | CC0 |
| `hmso-store-1950.png` | 240 x 181 | HMSO Store, Sighthill, Edinburgh 1950 | Francis Walley, HMSO | 1950 | Wikimedia Commons, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:HMSO_Store,_Sighthill,_Edinburgh_1950.jpg | public domain (Crown copyright expired) as marked at the source |
| `columbia-disc.png` | 360 x 270 | Columbia Disc Record Number 12 | Columbia Records | 1901 | Wikimedia Commons, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Columbia_Disc_Record_Number_12.jpg | public domain |

The pictures in `../golden/` are this package's own renders of these plates and of synthetic scenes.
